description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan charge-off scenarios in the Apache Fineract project. It includes tests for posting charge-off transactions, backdating transactions, reversing transactions, replaying transactions, and verifying corresponding journal entries and relational links between transactions.

classes.name: LoanPostChargeOffScenariosTest
classes.description: Integration test class for various loan charge-off scenarios, including posting, reversing, backdating, and verifying journal entries and transaction relationships.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test, setting up accounts and helpers.

methods.name: postChargeOffAddBackdatedTransactionTest
methods.description: Tests posting a charge-off transaction, backdating the process, and verifies journal entries, relationships, and subsequent repayments including goodwill credit.

methods.name: postChargeOffBackdatedTransactionReverseTest
methods.description: Tests reversing a backdated transaction after charge-off, including journal entries and relationships.

methods.name: postChargeOffBackdatedTransactionReverseReplayTest
methods.description: Tests reversing and replaying a backdated transaction after charge-off, verifying journal entries, transaction relations, and reconciliation.

methods.name: transactionOnChargeOffDatePreChargeOffReverseReplayTest
methods.description: Tests transactions occurring before and after the charge-off date, including reversals and replays, to verify journal consistency.

methods.name: transactionOnChargeOffDatePostChargeOffReverseReplayTest
methods.description: Tests transactions occurring after the charge-off date with reversals and replays, ensuring journal entries and transaction links are correct.

methods.name: transactionOnChargeOffDateReverseTest
methods.description: Verifies journal entries and transaction states when reversing a repayment on the charge-off date.
